blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Collaborative perception enables agents to retrieve the scene semantics and geometry beyond the field of view of any individual agent. This broader scene understanding enhances transportation safety and improves efficiency in multi-robot systems. However, existing collaborative semantic occupancy methods rely on dense 3D voxel annotations and are limited to recognizing objects within a predefined set of semantic classes. To overcome these limitations, we present CoGaussian, an open-vocabulary Gaussian-based collaborative semantic occupancy prediction framework. CoGaussian represents a scene as a set of foundation model-aligned sparse 3D Gaussians, which serve as a compact representation for communicating and fusing geometric and semantic information across multiple agents. On the Semantic-OPV2V benchmark, our method outperforms existing open-vocabulary single-agent approaches, highlighting the effectiveness of open-vocabulary collaborative scene understanding.
blocks.zh: 协作感知使特工能够获取场景语义和几何学,超越任何单个代理人的视野. 这种更广泛的场景理解增强了运输安全,提高了多机器人系统的效率. 然而,现有的协作语义占用方法依赖于密集的3D voxel注解,并且仅限于在预定义的一组语义类中识别对象. 为了克服这些局限性,我们提出了CoGaussian,一个开放式的、基于高斯语的合作语义占用预测框架。 CoGausian代表的场景是一组基础模型对齐的稀疏的3D Gaussians,它作为一个紧凑的表示,用于跨越多种物剂进行几何和语义信息的交流和交流. 在语义-OPV2V基准上,我们的方法优于现有的开放-省单剂方法,突出了开放-省合作场景理解的有效性.

blocks.en: I INTRODUCTION
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Collaborative perception enables local agents to exchange information that may be occluded or beyond their field-of-view, improving geometric and semantic understanding of their environment, and enabling safer and more reliable decision making in autonomous driving and robot navigation. Semantic occupancy prediction (SOP) is a representative and challenging task in 3D spatial understanding, which aims to predict voxel-wise occupancy status and semantic class. Recently, 3D Gaussian-based methods [ 1 ] have been shown to be effective for SOP. The GaussianFormer family [ 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 ] represents scenes as 3D Gaussians, supervised by dense occupancy labels. VOGS-CP [ 6 ] extends GaussianFormer to collaborative SOP which communicates Gaussian primitives between neighboring agents. However, these methods are limited to predicting semantics within a closed vocabulary and heavily rely on densely annotated 3D occupancy labels that are expensive to obtain.
blocks.zh: 协作感知使当地代理人能够交流其视野内或以外的信息,改善对其环境的几何和语义理解,并在自主驾驶和机器人导航方面作出更安全和更可靠的决策。 语义占用预测(SOP)是3D空间理解中一项具有代表性且具有挑战性的任务,其目的是预测阴道占用状态和语义类. 最近,基于3D高斯的方法[1]被证明对SOP有效. 高斯福尔默家族[2,3,4,5]代表场景为3D高斯人,受密集占用标签监督. VOGS-CP [6] 将GaussianFormer扩展为合作的SOP,后者将Gaussian原始人沟通于邻居代理. 然而,这些方法仅限于在封闭的词汇中预测语义学,并严重依赖内容繁多的3D占用标签,这些标签是昂贵的.

blocks.en:
Vision foundation models (VFMs), such as DINO [ 7 ] and CLIP [ 8 ] have demonstrated strong open-vocabulary capabilities in 2D perception. In addition, Talk2DINO [ 9 ] and DINO.txt [ 10 ] further align 2D VFM features with natural language.
Building on the above VFMs, GaussTR [ 11 ] represents scenes as a set of sparse open-vocabulary 3D Gaussians that are predicted in a feed-forward manner and can be queried via natural language. The Gaussians are encoded with geometry and semantic information by splatting into 2D views and aligning rendered features with foundation model-derived depth [ 12 ] and semantics [ 8 , 7 ] . However, GaussTR is designed for single-agent perception and cannot leverage information that is visible only to neighboring agents.
blocks.zh:
视觉基础模型(VFM),如DINO[7]和CLIP[8]在2D感知中表现出强大的开放-vobulity能力. 此外,Talk2DINO [9]和DINO.txt [10]进一步将2D VFM特征与自然语言对齐.
在上述VFMs的基础上,高斯TR [11] 代表场景为一组稀疏的开放-伏特加的3D高斯人,以向信息前进的方式预测,可以通过自然语言询问. 高斯人用几何学和语义学信息编码,方法是将拓扑成2D视图,并将制成的特征与基础模型衍生深度[12]和语义[8,7]对齐. 然而,高斯TR是针对单剂感知而设计的,不能利用只有邻居代理才能看到的信息.

blocks.en: Based on these observations, we propose CoGaussian , the first open-vocabulary multi-robot collaborative perception framework. We represent scenes as sets of sparse VFM-aligned 3D Gaussians, which also serve as the communication primitives among agents. We also explore and develop three different algorithms to aggregate and fuse information from neighboring agents. Our contributions can be summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 基于这些观察,我们提出CoGausian(英语:CoGausian),这是第一个开放式的多机器人协作感知框架. 我们代表的场景是几组与VFM相配的3D Gaussian人,他们也是特工之间的交流原始人。 我们还探索和开发了三种不同的算法,以汇总和熔化来自邻近代理人的信息. 我们的贡献可归纳如下:

blocks.en: • Open-Vocabulary Collaborative Perception: We propose CoGaussian, the first framework for open-vocabulary collaborative perception (e.g. 3D semantic occupancy prediction) in outdoor environments. • Multi-Robot 3D Gaussian Representation: We develop a foundation model-aligned 3D Gaussian representation for collaborative perception, along with fusion strategies to enhance information transfer among agents. • Zero-Shot Benchmarking: We evaluate CoGaussian on the Semantic-OPV2V [ 13 , 14 ] dataset in a zero-shot manner. Without any task-specific supervision, our approach achieves impressive performance for semantic occupancy prediction, highlighting the potential for open-vocabulary collaborative perception.
blocks.zh: • 支助 开放式词汇协作概念 : 我们提出CoGausian,这是户外环境中第一个开放-省协作感知的框架(如3D语义占用预测). • 多机器人3D高斯代表: 我们为协作感知开发一种基础模型式的3D高斯代表,同时制定聚变战略,加强代理人之间的信息传输。 • 零热度基准: 我们以零射法评价CoGausian在Semantic-OPV2V[13,14]数据集. 在没有任何针对具体任务的监督的情况下,我们的方法在语义占用预测方面取得了令人印象深刻的业绩,突出了开放式省协作感的潜力。

blocks.en: Open-Vocabulary Collaborative Perception: We propose CoGaussian, the first framework for open-vocabulary collaborative perception (e.g. 3D semantic occupancy prediction) in outdoor environments.

blocks.en: Fig. 2: Overview. CoGaussian starts with randomly initialized embeddings. A transformer layer uses multiscale features of images to update the embeddings, followed by a Head Layer that predicts Gaussians. During Joint Training, all agents predict ego Gaussians which are communicated with each other and aggregated. This set of Gaussians is used for training. In the Fusion pipeline, the neighbors predict and send Gaussian embeddings to the ego agent. Radius-gated Attention uses these neighbor Gaussian embeddings to update ego embeddings. The Fusion Head predicts ego Gaussians, and pre-trained Head from Joint Training predicts neighbor Gaussians. These are aggregated to form the final prediction used for both training and inference.

blocks.en: II Method
blocks.zh: 二. 方法

blocks.en: We represent a scene as a sparse set of 3D Gaussians with associated DINOv2 [ 7 ] features. Predicted Gaussians are splatted back into the source camera view and supervised by DINOv2 [ 7 ] features and Metric3Dv2 [ 12 ] monocular depth. During inference, semantic class logits are computed as similarity between the predicted Gaussian features and Talk2DINO [ 9 ] text embeddings for each class.
blocks.zh: 我们代表的场景是一组 3D 高斯人与相关的 DINOv2 [7] 特征。 预想中的高斯人被电镀回到源相机视图,并由DINOv2 [7] 特性和Metric3Dv2 [12] 单元深度监督. 在推论中,语义类对数作为预测的高斯语特征与Talk2DINO[9]文本嵌入每个类的相似性计算.

blocks.en: II-A Preliminaries
blocks.zh: A. 初步情况

The model inputs an image and initializes a set of Gaussian embeddings { 𝐪 𝐢 ∈ ℝ E } i = 1 N \{\mathbf{q_{i}}\in\mathbb{R}^{E}\}_{i=1}^{N} , where E E denotes the dimension of the embedding. The coordinates are concatenated with the depth value, and then projected into 3D space via camera intrinsics and LiDAR-camera extrinsics to obtain the Gaussian’s mean position 𝝁 \boldsymbol{\mu} in the LiDAR frame.
Once the Gaussian embeddings are initialized, they are refined through a set of transformer [ 15 ] layers ℱ \mathcal{F} that consists of a deformable attention module [ 16 ] , a self-attention module, and an MLP layer, as shown in Fig. 2 . The point ( u i , v i ) (u_{i},v_{i}) serves as the reference point for deformable attention over the image features: 𝐪 𝐢 ′ = ℱ ⁡ ( 𝐪 𝐢 , ( u i , v i ) ) . \mathbf{q_{i}^{\prime}}=\mathcal{F}(\mathbf{q_{i}},(u_{i},v_{i})). ( 2 ) Finally, the Gaussian parameters are predicted from embeddings 𝐪 𝐢 \mathbf{q_{i}} using an MLP head: g i := { Δ ​ 𝝁 i , 𝐬 i , 𝐫 i , α i , 𝐟 i } = MLP GH ⁡ ( 𝐪 𝐢 ′ ) . g_{i}:=\{\Delta\boldsymbol{\mu}_{i},\;\mathbf{s}_{i},\;\mathbf{r}_{i},\;\alpha_{i},\;\mathbf{f}_{i}\}=\operatorname{MLP_{GH}}(\mathbf{q_{i}^{\prime}}). ( 3 ) The means μ \mathbf{\mu} are iteratively refined after each layer using the predicted offsets Δ ​ μ \Delta\mathbf{\mu} , while the scale 𝐬 \mathbf{s} and opacity α \alpha are scaled to appropriate ranges. The rotations 𝐫 \mathbf{r} are fixed to be axis-aligned in the camera’s coordinate frame, and are not learned to simplify training.
The model is trained by differentiably rendering the DINOv2 features and depth from the predicted Gaussians using alpha-blending, implemented with optimized CUDA kernels [ 17 ] . The training objective penalizes the difference between the rendered outputs and corresponding predicted depth and features [ 11 ] .

blocks.en: II-B Joint Training
blocks.zh: 二-B 联合培训

blocks.en:
GaussTR [ 11 ] is trained per camera view , with Gaussians predicted from each camera splatted back into that view for supervision. While this approach is effective for datasets with limited camera overlap, such as in the nuScenes dataset [ 18 ] , it is suboptimal for multi-agent perception, where independent supervision fails to exploit overlapping observations across agents.
Therefore, the model is trained per scene as shown in Fig. 2 . All Gaussians predicted from cameras in a scene are aggregated and splatted into every camera in which they are visible, not only the cameras that produced them. Thus, predictions consistent with a single view but inconsistent with other views are penalized.
During inference, Gaussians are predicted from each camera, aggregated, and then used by agents for downstream tasks. CoGaussian can use weights from either per-image or per-scene training. In Sec. III , we refer to the former as Zero-shot Concatenation , which combines per-image training with our proposed inference method, and the later as Joint Training , which uses per-scene training to enable collaboration.
blocks.zh:
GaussTR [11] 每个摄像头都受过训练, 虽然这种方法对于相机重叠程度有限的数据集是有效的,例如在nuScens数据集[18]中,但对于多代理感知来说,这种方法并不理想,因为独立监督未能利用跨代理的重叠观测.
因此,模型每个场景都经过训练,如图所示. 2,从场景中的摄像头预言的所有高斯人都被集合起来,并被镀在每一个可见的摄像头中,而不仅仅是产生它们的摄像头. 因此,符合单一观点但与其他观点不一致的预测将受到惩罚。
在推论期间,高斯人从每个相机中预测,聚合,然后被特工用于下游任务. CoGausian可以使用每个图像或每个场景训练的重量. 在Sec. III中,我们把前者称为零射合一(Zero-shot Concatenation),它结合了每个图像训练与我们提议的推论方法,而后称为联合训练(Joint Training),它使用每个场景训练来促成协作.

blocks.en: II-C Radius-Gated Attention Fusion
blocks.zh: II-C 半径- 注意力融合

blocks.en:
Joint Training improves performance as reported in Table I . However, aggregating Gaussians from different cameras with overlapping fields of view causes the respective Gaussians to overlap. While this adds information for the ego, it also introduces noise. Additionally, the appearance of the same object often varies across different viewpoints. Thus, Gaussians for the same object may differ widely. Joint training helps mitigate such differences, but it does so implicitly during Gaussian prediction. Therefore, we make this explicit by introducing a fusion module.
The fusion module aggregates useful information from Gaussians predicted by neighboring agents. We use single-head scaled dot product attention [ 15 ] between ego Gaussian embeddings and neighboring Gaussian embeddings. Afterwards, a Fusion Head with the same architecture as the Gaussian Head predicts Gaussians from the updated embeddings. The updated ego Gaussians and the neighboring Gaussians are aggregated to form the final set used for downstream tasks. The fusion pipeline is shown in Fig. 2 .
blocks.zh:
联合培训提高了业绩,如表一所示。 然而,将不同的相机中的高斯人集合在一起,具有重叠的视野,导致相应的高斯人重叠. 虽然这增加了自我的信息,但也引入了噪音. 此外,同一物体的外观往往因不同观点而异。 因此, 高斯人对同一个物体可能有很大的不同. 联合培训有助于减轻这种差异,但在高斯预测期间却含蓄地这样做。 因此,我们通过引入一个聚变模块来阐明这一点。
聚变模块汇总了邻近物剂预测的来自高斯人的有用信息. 我们使用单头缩放点产品关注度[15] 在自负高斯嵌入和相邻高斯嵌入之间. 之后,一个具有与高斯海头相同的架构的Fusion Head从更新的嵌入中预测高斯海头. 更新的自我高斯人和邻近的高斯人被汇总,形成用于下游任务的最终集. 聚变管道在图2中显示.

blocks.en: Training. We follow a two-stage training paradigm. Stage 1: We train the Transformer Layer and Gaussian Head as described in Sec. II-B . Stage 2: The Transformer Layer and Gaussian Head are frozen, and the model learns the Radius-Gated Attention Layer and the Fusion Head.

blocks.en: III EXPERIMENTS
blocks.zh: 三. 警告

blocks.en: TABLE I: 3D Semantic Occupancy Prediction on Semantic-OPV2V Dataset
blocks.zh: 表一:关于语义-OPV2V的3D语义占用预测 数据集

blocks.en: III-A Dataset and Metrics
blocks.zh: 数据集和计量

blocks.en:
We evaluate on the Semantic-OPV2V benchmark [ 14 ] , an extension of OPV2V dataset [ 13 ] with 3D SOP ground truth. OPV2V is a simulated dataset for vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) collaboration with two to seven collaborating agents in a scene. Each vehicle is equipped with 4 cameras. The ground truth consists of 12 semantic labels over a 40 × 40 × 3.2 ​ m 40\times 40\times 3.2m area with a grid size of 100 × 100 × 8 100\times 100\times 8 , giving a voxel size of 0.4 ​ m 0.4m .
Following previous work [ 6 , 14 ] , we report the per-class Intersection-over-Union (IoU), and its mean (mIoU), along with the overall occupancy IoU. Even though fully-supervised methods are included for reference, they are not comparable to our approach as they use dense 3D voxel supervision.
blocks.zh:
我们用语义-OPV2V基准 [14] 来评价 OPV2V 数据集的扩展 [13] 3D SOP 地面真相. OPV2V是一个模拟数据集,用于车辆对车辆(V2V)在一幕中与2到7名协作代理进行协作. 每辆车配备4个摄像头. 地面真言由12个语义标签组成,范围为40×40×3.2米40×时,面积为3.2米,网格大小为100×100×8100×100×8100×时,长度为0.4米0.4米.
继先前的工作[6,14]之后,我们报告每类跨节联(IoU)及其平均值(mIoU),以及整体占用IoU. 尽管包括了完全监督的方法以供参考,但是它们与我们的方法并不相似,因为它们使用密集的3D voxel监督.

blocks.en: III-B Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 三-B 执行细节

blocks.en: The model is trained per-view for 6 epochs for single-agent and zero-shot concatenation. Joint per-scene training is then run for 3 epochs. For Radius-Gated Attention Fusion, the transformer is frozen, and the attention module and fusion head are trained for 3 epochs. All training runs use a single NVIDIA A100 GPU and take 8-14 hours. The losses converge within 2 epochs for all runs. Metric3Dv2 [ 12 ] provides depth supervision, and DINOv2 [ 7 ] provides open-vocabulary feature supervision. During inference, Gaussian features are compared with text embeddings aligned to DINOv2 using Talk2DINO [ 9 ] , prompted with the 12 classes plus an extra class representing free space. We use AdamW with a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} , weight decay of 5 × 10 − 3 5\times 10^{-3} , and gradient clipping of 20. We evaluate models using 1200 Gaussian queries per camera in four configurations: • Single Agent Perception: Each agent independently predicts occupancy. • Zero-shot Concatenation: Gaussians predicted by all agents are aggregated in a common coordinate frame. • Joint Training: Aggregated Gaussians from all cameras are used for fine-tuning. • Radius-Gated Attention: The fusion pipeline runs for each agent, updating ego Gaussians using neighboring Gaussians.
blocks.zh: 该模型为6个世纪的单剂和零弹孔结合而训练了每个视图. 然后对3个学期进行联合人均培训。 对于Radius-Gated的注意力融合,变压器被冻结,注意力模块和聚变头被训练为3个纪元. 所有训练运行都使用单NVIDIA A100 GPU,需要8-14小时. 损失在两个时代之内汇合,对所有人都开放。 Metric3Dv2 [12] 提供深度监督,DINOv2 [7] 提供开放式的vocabulary特征监督. 在推论中,高斯的特性被比作使用Talk2DINO [9] 与 DINOv2 对齐的文本嵌入,由12类加一个代表自由空间的附加类引起. 我们使用 AdamW 的学习率为 1×10 − 5 1\ Times 10×5 },体重衰减为 5×10 − 3 5\ Times 10×3 } 梯度剪切为 20 。 我们用1200高斯式的每台相机查询来评价模型,分为4个配置: 单剂感知: 每个特工都独立预测占用情况. • 零射协和: 所有物剂预言的高斯人被集合在一个共同的坐标框中. • 联合培训: 所有摄像头中加在一起的高斯人用于微调. • 半径注意: 聚变管道为每个毒剂运行,利用邻近的高斯人更新自我.

blocks.en: IV RESULTS AND DISCUSSION
blocks.zh: 四、结果和讨论

blocks.en: IV-A Quantitative Results
blocks.zh: 四A 量化结果

blocks.en: Table I highlights quantitative results from previous works, as well as our experiments. Relative to the single-agent GaussTR baseline, zero-shot concatenation reduces performance by − 4.45 \mathbf{-4.45} / − 1.45 \mathbf{-1.45} (IoU/mIoU), showing that naive Gaussian aggregation introduces spatially inconsistent structure. Joint Training improves over the baseline by + 1.96 \mathbf{+1.96} / + 0.48 \mathbf{+0.48} (IoU/mIoU), indicating that cross-view rendering supervision reconciles these inconsistencies. Using Radius-Gated Attention gives a modest gain of + 1.99 \mathbf{+1.99} / + 0.69 \mathbf{+0.69} (IoU/mIoU) over the baseline.
blocks.zh: 图表 我强调以前工作的数量结果,以及我们的实验。 相对于单剂高斯TR基线,零射接力将性能降低−4.45\mathbf{-4.45}/−1.45\mathbf{-1.45}(IoU/mIoU),表明天真的高斯聚合引入了空间不一致的结构. 联合培训比基线改进了1.96\mathbf\1.96}/+0.48\mathbf\0.48}(IoU/mIoU),表明交叉视图使监督调和了这些不一致之处。 使用半径- Gated 注意使 + 1.99\ mathbf{+1.99} / + 0.69\ mathbf{+0.69} (IoU/mIoU) 比基线稍有增益.

blocks.en: Class-wise behavior is mixed, with frequently observed classes like “road”, “sidewalk”, and “vehicles” benefiting the most from collaboration, as they have major overlap among agents and thus a stronger supervision signal. Prominent but less visible classes like ”vegetation” and ”terrain” struggle with collaboration and other small and uncommon classes have mixed results.
blocks.zh: 阶级行为有好有坏,经常观察到“道路”、“侧行道”和“车辆”等类别从协作中受益最大,因为这些类别在代理人之间有重大重叠,因此是一种更强有力的监督信号。 诸如“植被”和“地形”等著名但不太引人注目的阶层与协作和其他小而不寻常的阶层的斗争,结果好坏参半。

blocks.en: IV-B Qualitative Results
blocks.zh: 定性结果

blocks.en: Fig. 1 shows that the collaborative methods recover structure outside the ego view. Our method tends to produce volumetric predictions rather than one voxel thick surfaces in the ground truth. This reflects the nature of sparse 3D Gaussian representations, unlike methods like [ 2 , 3 , 4 ] that rely on 3D semantic voxel supervision and many surface-fitting small Gaussians. 2D image-based supervision also makes objects occupying large image regions more prominent in 3D space. The elongated prediction of Vehicle 1 and volumetric prediction of Vehicle 2 demonstrate this behavior.
blocks.zh: 图1显示协作方法在自我观之外恢复结构. 我们的方法往往产生体积的预测,而不是在地面的真理中产生一个阴道厚的表面. 这反映了稀疏的3D高斯代表物的性质,不同于像[2,3,4]那样依赖于3D语义性 voxel 监理和许多表面匹配的小高斯人的方法. 基于2D图像的监控也使得占据大图像区域的物体在3D空间中更为突出. 对1号机车的长时间预测和对2号机车的体积预测证明了这种行为.

blocks.en: Joint Training reduces these inconsistencies, producing smaller and more conservative Gaussians, evident in Vehicle 2 and smaller elliptical predictions throughout the scene. The fusion pipeline preserves this coherence while recovering more dominant regions of the scene, including the Road and some Vehicles. However, thin and infrequent structures remain difficult to reconstruct reliably under purely 2D self-supervision.
blocks.zh: 联合训练减少了这些不一致之处,产生了更小更保守的高斯人,在全场2号机车和较小的椭圆预测中都很明显. 聚变管道保持了这种一致性,同时恢复了场景中较为占主导地位的区域,包括道路和一些车辆. 然而,在纯粹的2D自监控下,稀疏和不常用的结构仍然难以可靠地重建.

blocks.en: V CONCLUSION AND FUTURE WORK
blocks.zh: 五、结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: We introduce CoGaussian which is, to the best of our knowledge, the first framework for open-vocabulary collaborative perception that communicates foundation model-aligned 3D Gaussians among agents to represent a scene. Evaluation shows that collaboration is effective when interaction is learned. Zero-shot collaboration hurts performance, whereas joint training and radius-gated attention improve over the single-agent baseline. CoGaussian also brings the flexibility of open-vocabulary to collaborative perception.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍CoGausian, 就我们所知,这是第一个开放-省合作认识的框架, 将基建模型与3D Gaussians 互相沟通, 以代表一个场景。 评价表明,在学习互动时,协作是有效的。 零射合作会损害性能,而联合训练和半径集中的注意力则比单剂基线有所改善。 CoGausian还给合作感知带来了开放-伏特加的灵活性.

blocks.en: We plan to explore different fusion architectures and evaluate additional downstream tasks such as BEV Semantic Segmentation and 3D Object Detection. Efficient communication and inference optimization will also be crucial for enabling real-time implementation.
blocks.zh: 我们计划探索不同的聚变架构,并评价额外的下游任务,如BEV语义分裂和3D对象检测. 高效的沟通和推论优化对于促进实时执行也至关重要。
